header:
Diesel +71% in a year
The weekend twist

lines.text: Diesel costs 71% more than a year ago, per AAA.
lines.say: Diesel costs seventy-one percent more than a year ago.

lines.text: On Sunday, Trump said Russia and Ukraine agreed to an energy ceasefire.
lines.say: On Sunday, Trump said Russia and Ukraine agreed to an energy ceasefire.

lines.text: EIA: a record $6.529 a gallon the week of Sept 21, then $6.199 the week of Oct 5.
lines.say: Government data shows a record near six fifty-three a gallon in late September, then about six twenty in early October.

lines.text: Friday: a Trump-Putin diesel deal and a US sanctions waiver. Saturday: Russia eased its export ban. Sunday: the ceasefire claim.
lines.say: Friday, a Putin diesel deal and a sanctions waiver. Saturday, Russia eased its export ban. Sunday, the ceasefire claim.

lines.text: Trump says Russia will ship 300,000+ tons now, then 500,000 tons in November.
lines.say: Trump says Russia will ship over three hundred thousand tons now, then five hundred thousand in November.

lines.text: Experts doubt prices move much. Michael Lynch, quoted in Fortune: "It's kind of shuffling deck chairs on the Titanic."
lines.say: Experts doubt prices move much. One said, quote, it's kind of shuffling deck chairs on the Titanic.

scene.text: It's kind of shuffling deck chairs on the Titanic.
scene.source: Michael Lynch, EPRF, via Fortune, Oct 10, 2026

lines.text: Why it matters: diesel moves trucks, trains and tractors, so it's baked into shipping and food costs.
lines.say: Why it matters: diesel moves trucks, trains and tractors, so it's baked into shipping and food costs.

lines.text: As of Sunday, Moscow hadn't confirmed it. Zelensky called it "news for me." A similar claim in September didn't stop strikes.
lines.say: Moscow hadn't confirmed it, and Zelensky called it, quote, news for me. A similar claim in September didn't stop strikes.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.
lines.say: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: Diesel Is Up 71% in a Year. Then Came Sunday's Surprise
post.ig:
Diesel costs 71% more than a year ago, per AAA.
AAA: national average about $6.28 a gallon, after a record $6.53 on Sept 22. EIA's weekly record was $6.529 (week of Sept 21, 2026).
Oct 9: Trump announced a diesel deal with Putin; Treasury waived sanctions on Russian diesel through April 2027.
Oct 10: Russia partly lifted its diesel export ban (about 500,000 tons).
Oct 11: Trump said Russia and Ukraine agreed to an energy ceasefire (a similar claim in September didn't stop strikes); Moscow had not confirmed and Zelensky called it "news for me."
Sources: EIA, AAA, CNBC, Fortune, CNN, AFP, Kyiv Independent.
News and education, not financial advice.
